name: Spring: actuator env -> heapdump tokens -> gateway SpEL RCE
goal: From exposed Spring Boot actuators to configuration secrets, in-memory session tokens, and a pre-auth SpEL RCE.
preconditions: Spring Boot with exposed management endpoints (classic :8080 app or gateway).
impact: Config secrets + session tokens + code execution on the gateway/app.

steps.purpose: Read /actuator/env: datasource creds, cloud keys, internal route map.
steps.on_success: Triage secrets; step 2 for in-memory tokens.
steps.on_fail: env blocked -> mappings/heapdump may still be open.

steps.purpose: Download heapdump; mine strings for active session IDs, tokens, cached credentials.
steps.on_success: Session tokens -> immediate authenticated access; gadget libraries visible for step 3.
steps.on_fail: heapdump blocked -> work with env alone; try jolokia (documented variant).

steps.purpose: If a Spring Cloud Gateway is present: pre-auth SpEL injection -> RCE.
steps.on_fail: No gateway -> Log4Shell probe (web/Log4Shell JNDI lookup error probe) against Spring logging surfaces; spring4shell (documented variant).

steps.purpose: Deterministic OS proof through the RCE channel.

recon.name: Actuator census
recon.how: Probe /actuator, /env, /heapdump, /mappings, /jolokia directly and via one-hop proxies (headers confusion).
